name: Jeweled Pendant
summary: The Jeweled Pendant is a finely made noble’s ornament found among Alliance soldiers near Theramore. Its presence in the hands of common troops has drawn the Horde’s attention.

sections.title: A Soldier’s Prize
sections.body: Near Theramore, Marg saw an Alliance soldier wearing a pendant set with more gems than a common soldier could afford. Marg stole it from the camp, but a muckshell killed him on his way back. The pendant was recovered and brought to Nazeer in Brackenwall Village, where its fine workmanship raised a question about its true owner.

sections.title: A Noble’s Work
sections.body: Zor Lonetree, who is well schooled in Alliance politics, now studies the pendant in Orgrimmar. He sees the skill of its craft and believes many humans might covet such a jewel. Its owner remains unknown, while the Horde waits to learn what the ornament may reveal.

faq.answer: The pendant’s owner is unknown. Marg saw it on an Alliance soldier near Theramore, though its fine workmanship suggests it belonged to a noble.

faq.q: Why did Marg steal the pendant?
faq.answer: Marg saw an Alliance soldier wearing a pendant laden with gems and stole it from the camp near Theramore.
A muckshell killed Marg as he returned to base with the pendant he had stolen from the Alliance camp.

faq.q: Why does the Horde care about the pendant?
faq.answer: The pendant appears to be a noble’s work, yet an Alliance soldier wore it near Theramore. Zor Lonetree is studying it for clues to its owner.
Zor Lonetree is studying the Jeweled Pendant in Orgrimmar.

angles.text: The pendant offers the Horde a possible clue to Alliance noble affairs. Zor Lonetree is studying its craftsmanship and history.
A Stormwind soldier was seen wearing this finely made pendant near Theramore, and its unknown owner may be a noble.
